title: memoforge profiles/<name>/meta.json
description: Style profile metadata under config.plugin_data_dir/profiles/. Extraction logic is unchanged from v1.1.1 (TZ v1.5 section 0.3, section 4.6); this schema pins the shape written by `mf style` and read by the plan gate.

name.description: Profile directory name; same validation as `mf style validate-name`.

mode_binding.description: Applied on the plan gate before the mode is fixed, overriding the Mode answer (TZ section 2.4).

confidence.description: The unchanged v1 style-extractor writes a number; `mf style` may write the enum (D-16).
